moments.title: Strictly's Movie Week & First Elimination
moments.blurb: Tonight is Strictly Come Dancing's much-anticipated Movie Week, with all couples performing to iconic film tracks, ahead of the first elimination on Sunday.

angles.name: Movie Magic
angles.copy: Lights, Camera, Action! It's Movie Week on Strictly tonight and the pressure is on. Who are you backing to dazzle the judges and avoid tomorrow's first elimination?

angles.name: Elimination Nerves
angles.copy: The first Strictly elimination looms! After tonight's Movie Week spectacular, one couple will be leaving. Who do you think is most at risk?

moments.title: Taylor Swift Claims UK Chart Double
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift has achieved her eighth UK number-one single with 'Patient Zero' and a chart double, as 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore' returns to the top of the UK Albums Chart.

angles.name: Swift's Reign Continues
angles.copy: Queen of the charts! Taylor Swift has done it again, scoring her eighth UK Number 1 single with 'Patient Zero' AND a chart double with her album. Is there anything she can't do?

angles.name: Chart Double Delight
angles.copy: Another chart double for Taylor Swift! 'Patient Zero' is officially the UK's Number 1 single, and 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore' is back at the top of the album chart. Which track are you streaming?

moments.title: Nations League Action for England & Scotland
moments.blurb: England faces Croatia at 5:00 PM and Scotland takes on North Macedonia at 7:45 PM in UEFA Nations League matches today.

angles.name: England's Challenge
angles.copy: Big day for the Three Lions! England are in Nations League action against Croatia at 5pm. Can they secure a vital win?

angles.name: Scotland on the Road
angles.copy: Come on Scotland! Our boys are away to North Macedonia in the Nations League tonight at 7:45pm. How are we feeling about this one?

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday, Gwen Stefani!
moments.blurb: Iconic No Doubt frontwoman and solo superstar Gwen Stefani celebrates her 57th birthday today. She was born on October 3, 1969.

angles.name: Gwen's Big Day
angles.copy: Feeling 'Hella Good' today? It's Gwen Stefani's 57th birthday! From No Doubt classics to solo smash hits, what's your favourite Gwen track?

angles.name: No Doubt About It
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the one and only Gwen Stefani! Still looking and sounding incredible. What's the ultimate No Doubt anthem?

moments.title: Happy 55th Birthday, Kevin Richardson!
moments.blurb: Backstreet Boys member Kevin Richardson turns 55 today, having been born on October 3, 1971.

angles.name: Backstreet's Back
angles.copy: Alright! Sending huge birthday wishes to Kevin Richardson of the Backstreet Boys, who's 55 today! What's your go-to BSB song?

angles.name: Kevin's 55th
angles.copy: He's still 'Larger Than Life'! Happy 55th Birthday to Kevin Richardson. Share your favourite Backstreet Boys memory!

moments.title: GBBO's Biscuit Week Star Baker
moments.blurb: Tom from West Yorkshire was crowned Star Baker during The Great British Bake Off's Biscuit Week on September 29, impressing new judge Nigella Lawson and Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Biscuit Brilliance
angles.copy: Still thinking about Bake Off's Biscuit Week? Tom's creations earned him Star Baker! Who else is craving an American-style cookie or an iced gem?

angles.name: Danni's Exit
angles.copy: The Bake Off tent said goodbye to Danni during Biscuit Week. A sad farewell, but what an effort! Who do you think will be Star Baker next?

moments.title: New Legal Drama 'War' on Sky Atlantic
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated legal drama 'War', starring Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a couple in an acrimonious divorce, premiered on Sky Atlantic last night (October 2).

angles.name: Weekend Watch
angles.copy: Catching up on new TV this weekend? Dominic West and Sienna Miller's new legal drama 'War' just dropped on Sky Atlantic. Get ready for some high-stakes divorce drama!

angles.name: TV Showdown
angles.copy: Dominic West vs. Sienna Miller in 'War' on Sky Atlantic. Who's tuning in for this intense new legal battle series?

moments.title: Europe's 'Final Countdown' 40th Anniversary Tour
moments.blurb: Swedish rock band Europe celebrates 40 years of 'The Final Countdown' with a tour, including a stop at London's Eventim Apollo tonight.

angles.name: It's The Final Countdown!
angles.copy: Rock legends Europe are bringing their 'Final Countdown' 40th Anniversary tour to London's Eventim Apollo tonight! Who's ready to sing along?

angles.name: 40 Years of Countdown
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 40 years since 'The Final Countdown'? Europe are celebrating in style with a gig tonight. What's your favourite track from the album?

moments.title: Wales October Half Term Starts Next Week
moments.blurb: Schoolchildren in Wales are looking forward to their Autumn Half Term, which runs from Monday, October 12, to Friday, October 23.

angles.name: Half Term Countdown
angles.copy: Just over a week until the October Half Term for schools across Wales! What are your plans for the break?

angles.name: Family Fun in Wales
angles.copy: Thinking ahead to October Half Term? It kicks off next Monday in Wales, running until the 23rd. Plenty of time for family adventures!

moments.title: Exmoor Dark Skies Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival, celebrating the region's International Dark Sky Reserve status, runs from October 16 to November 1, offering stargazing and related events.

angles.name: Stargazing on Exmoor
angles.copy: Get ready for celestial wonders! The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival starts on October 16th. Perfect for a night under the stars in Devon and Somerset.

angles.name: Devon After Dark
angles.copy: Looking for something different next week? The Exmoor Dark Skies Festival is a great reason to explore our beautiful region after sunset. Who's going?

moments.title: Bushmills Salmon & Whiskey Festival Continues
moments.blurb: The Bushmills Salmon & Whiskey Festival in Northern Ireland celebrates local produce and heritage, running from October 2-4.

angles.name: Northern Ireland Flavours
angles.copy: It's the final day for the Bushmills Salmon & Whiskey Festival in Northern Ireland! If you're in the area, don't miss out on celebrating some fantastic local produce.

angles.name: Whiskey & More
angles.copy: Last chance to experience the Bushmills Salmon & Whiskey Festival today! A brilliant celebration of Northern Irish food and drink.
